final:
-- Ids are base + i, where base comes only from seed. No capabilities are
-- used, so the result is the same on every run for the same seed.

all_distinct(xs: List[int]) -> bool =
  ex all_distinct([1, 2, 3]) == True
  ex all_distinct([4, 4]) == False
  for i in range(0, xs.len())
    for j in range(i + 1, xs.len())
      if xs[i] == xs[j]
        return False
  True

make_ids(n: int, seed: int) -> List[int] =
  pre n >= 0
  post out.len() == n
  post all_distinct(out)
  ex make_ids(0, 5) == []
  ex make_ids(3, 0) == [0, 1, 2]
  ex make_ids(2, 5) == [5, 6]
  let base = seed % 1000000
  var ids: List[int] = []
  for i in range(0, n)
    ids.append(base + i)
  ids
